title: Run Program plugin initialization fails with disabled package service

status.label: Maintainer-directed duplicate
status.detail: A maintainer explicitly routed this report to #34216. This issue remains open; that linked issue is closed, which is not proof of a code fix.

next_action.label: Consolidate the matching service failure
next_action.reason: Use the posted PackageCatalog/0x80070422 evidence and existing duplicate direction rather than inventing another ownership claim.

judgment.rationale: Explicit maintainer duplicate direction is corroborated by matching PackageCatalog subscription failures with ERROR_SERVICE_DISABLED in both reports. No resolution of every plugin failure is implied.
evidence: The author supplied a diagnostic ZIP; the posted stack identifies PackageRepository construction, PackageCatalog.add_PackageInstalling and HRESULT 0x80070422.
The discussion includes later reports on 0.65.0 and a reinstall workaround, not a universal fix.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/34216#issuecomment-2278493460 identifies the same HRESULT and package-event subscription path.
#34216 is closed; this issue is still open and unassigned. No concrete merged fix was identified.
judgment.recommended_action: Confirm the existing duplicate disposition with the matching stack evidence; do not request the diagnostic evidence already supplied.

fix_assessment.rationale: A separate competing fix plan is not applicable to this maintainer-directed duplicate. Public stack evidence matches #34216; neither closing that tracker nor disabling Run establishes a code-level fix.

issue_context.summary: Run's Program plugin fails to initialize; supplied diagnostics identify a disabled Windows service during package-catalog event registration, and a maintainer directs consolidation with #34216.
known_information: Original report is on 0.61.1 and already includes requested diagnostics in the discussion.
The published stack gives 0x80070422 at PackageCatalog.add_PackageInstalling.
The linked newer report has the same failure path, and the final maintainer comment explicitly requests duplicate housekeeping.
inferences: The matching service-disabled path supports consolidation of these reports, but other commenters' generic plugin dialogs may have different causes.
issue_context.analysis: Use actual duplicate direction and matching diagnostic evidence instead of the legacy false assignment rationale. Do not interpret the linked issue's closure or module-disable workaround as confirmed remediation.
initial_investigation: Reviewed all comments, existing ZIP links and the public stack excerpt without claiming to have analyzed the archive.
Checked related #34216, its service-disabled diagnostic comment, timeline cross-references and numeric fix search.

actions.label: Explain matching PackageCatalog duplicate

comment.body: The diagnostic ZIP already supplied here led to a stack showing PackageCatalog.add_PackageInstalling failing with 0x80070422 (ERROR_SERVICE_DISABLED). The newer report #34216 contains the same package-event subscription failure: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/34216#issuecomment-2278493460. This supports the earlier maintainer direction to consolidate this report with #34216: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/19845#issuecomment-2334727143. The linked issue is closed, but that closure alone does not establish that the underlying service failure was fixed; generic plugin-load dialogs with different exceptions should not be assumed to have this same cause.

actions.note: Draft duplicate rationale only; no comment or closure has been performed.
